info.title: Pav Enterprise API
info.description:
Read-only `/v1` API over Pav's biopharma dataset: drug programs, companies, clinical trials, deals, patent families, FDA records, a change feed, and dataset stats.

Authenticate every request with a Pav API key as a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Mint a key in [Pav developer settings](https://app.pav.bio/settings/developer).

All endpoints are `GET` and return JSON. List endpoints return a `{ data, pagination }` envelope. Pass `q=` to run relevance-ranked search that matches meaning as well as exact words; omit it for a filtered, paginated listing. Errors return `{ error: { code, message, request_id } }`.

get.description: Type-ahead suggestions for a program search box. Given a partial `q=` and optional active filters, runs the same search as `GET /v1/programs` and returns the top matching programs (company, drug, indication) — not facet values. Select one and filter by its `company_id`, or submit `q=` to `GET /v1/programs` for the full page.

get.description:
Search and filter the Pav pipeline of drug programs.

Provide `q=` for relevance-ranked search, or omit it for a filtered, sortable listing. Filters and `q=` combine with AND, and `include_total=true` adds the exact match count to either. Only `active` programs are listed unless `status` asks for others. Use `view=slim` for light rows when scanning many programs.

Filter coverage note: `target` and `modality` have partial coverage in the source data. Filtering on a sparsely populated field restricts results to programs where that field is populated, which can shrink the result set.

get.description:
List clinical trials linked to one company, in the same role-aware shape as `/v1/trials/{nct_id}` (`lead_sponsor`, `collaborators`, `sponsors`, `company_ids`, `programs`).

A trial is linked to a company through either path:
- **program** — a Pav program the company owns is linked to the trial (`via=program`);
- **sponsor** — the trial's sponsor organization is linked to the company (`via=sponsor`).

By default the trials of the companies it owns are included (`include_subsidiaries`).

`via=any` (default) returns the union. Filter by trial `phase` and `status`, and order with `sort` (e.g. `sort=start_date` for the newest first); without them trials come in NCT id order. With a filter or `sort`, `offset + limit` can be at most 1000. Pass `include_total=true` for an exact match count. Returns `404 not_found` if the company id is unknown.

get.description:
List or search ClinicalTrials.gov trials with their links to Pav programs and companies. Filters combine with AND; repeated values of one filter combine with OR.

`condition` matches the registry's own disease classification (MeSH): a disease name or synonym such as `ulcerative colitis` or `NSCLC`, a MeSH id such as `D003093`, or a MONDO id such as `MONDO:0005101`. It also matches trials filed under narrower terms (`inflammatory bowel diseases` includes ulcerative colitis and Crohn disease). `start_date_from` / `start_date_to` bound the start date (inclusive) and leave out trials with no start date. `sponsor` is the lead sponsor name, case-insensitive; `company_id` matches trials linked to that Pav company as sponsor or collaborator.

`include_total=true` returns the exact match count when listing without `q`; relevance search (`q`) reports `pagination.total = null`. Relevance search rejects an explicit `sort` because it ranks by query match. `offset + limit` may not exceed 1000.

data.title: Data
data.description: Page of program rows: full `Program` records by default, or `ProgramSummary` rows with `view=slim`.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Stable company id — send back as a `company_id` filter.

ProgramSuggestion.title: ProgramSuggestion
ProgramSuggestion.description: One search-as-you-type suggestion: a concrete program, not a facet value.

ProgramSuggestionList.title: ProgramSuggestionList
ProgramSuggestionList.description: Search-as-you-type program suggestions, best match first.

discontinued_at.title: Discontinued At
discontinued_at.description: When a `discontinued` program stopped; null otherwise.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: How Pav knows of this program: `company_pipeline`, `regulatory_approval` (an approved use the company's pipeline does not list) or `clinical_trial_registry`.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company id that owns this program.

drug_id.title: Drug Id
drug_id.description: Pav drug identifier shared by every program of the same drug product.

trial_count.title: Trial Count
trial_count.description: Number of clinical trials linked to the program.

ProgramSummary.title: ProgramSummary
ProgramSummary.description: A light program row for scanning lists; fetch the full record by `id`.

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: The program the similar set was computed for.

data.title: Data
data.description: Programs most similar to the source program, ranked by similarity.

name.title: Name
name.description: Sponsor organization name exactly as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov.

role.title: Role
role.description: Sponsor role on the trial: `lead_sponsor`, `collaborator`, or `owner`.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier this sponsor is linked to. Null when the sponsor is not a tracked company.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Slug of the Pav company this organization is linked to, when linked.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Total number of pipeline programs tracked.

distinct_phases.title: Distinct Phases
distinct_phases.description: Count of distinct normalized phases present.

distinct_modalities.title: Distinct Modalities
distinct_modalities.description: Count of distinct normalized modalities present.

by_phase.title: By Phase
by_phase.description: Program counts grouped by normalized phase.

by_modality.title: By Modality
by_modality.description: Program counts grouped by normalized modality.

ontology.title: Ontology
ontology.description: Ontology of the target term (NCIT or HGNC).

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: Target text the term was mapped from.

gene_symbol.title: Gene Symbol
gene_symbol.description: Official HGNC gene symbol when the target is a human gene product; null for non-gene targets such as a carbohydrate antigen or a pathogen. One gene can appear under different term ids (a gene class, a protein class, an HGNC entry), so group and match targets by this symbol.

nct_url.title: Nct Url
nct_url.description: ClinicalTrials.gov URL for the trial record.

title.title: Title
title.description: Official or brief title of the trial.
examples: A Study of a Vaccine to Prevent COVID-19

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Trial phase as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

status.title: Status
status.description: Overall recruitment/operational status of the trial.

program_count.title: Program Count
program_count.description: Number of Pav programs linked to this trial.

company_short_names.title: Company Short Names
company_short_names.description: Slugs of companies whose Pav programs are linked to this trial. For sponsor-based links as well, see `company_ids` and `sponsors`.

lead_sponsor.description: Lead sponsor as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov. Null when the registry record names no sponsor organization (e.g. some pre-2016 records).

collaborators.title: Collaborators
collaborators.description: Collaborator sponsors as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: All sponsors (lead, collaborators, owners), lead sponsor first.

company_ids.title: Company Ids
company_ids.description: Pav company ids linked to this trial as a sponsor or through their programs (deduplicated, sorted). Use them to join trials to companies and programs.

programs.title: Programs
programs.description: Pav programs linked to this trial.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Trial start date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

last_update_post_date.title: Last Update Post Date
last_update_post_date.description: Date the trial record was last updated on ClinicalTrials.gov.

primary_completion_date.title: Primary Completion Date
primary_completion_date.description: Primary completion date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov — the date the last participant was examined or received an intervention for primary-outcome data collection. A key resolution date.

completion_date.title: Completion Date
completion_date.description: Study completion date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

results_first_post_date.title: Results First Post Date
results_first_post_date.description: Date results were first posted on ClinicalTrials.gov. Null until the trial has posted results.

why_stopped.title: Why Stopped
why_stopped.description: Free-text reason the trial stopped early, as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov. Null for trials that did not stop early.

primary_outcomes.title: Primary Outcomes
primary_outcomes.description: The trial's primary outcome measures (primary endpoints) as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

nct_id.title: Nct Id
nct_id.description: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier of the changed trial.

title.title: Title
examples: A Study of Tulisokibart in Ulcerative Colitis

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What changed: `trial` (the trial was registered, or removed from the registry), `status` (overall recruitment status), `phase`, `start_date`, `primary_completion_date`, `completion_date`, `results_posted` (results first posted), `enrollment` (target or actual participant count), or `why_stopped`.

change_type.title: Change Type
change_type.description: `insert` (value first set, or a new trial), `update` (value changed), or `delete` (value removed, or the trial left the registry).

old_value.title: Old Value
old_value.description: Value before the change, as the registry states it. Phases are joined with `|`; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM`.

new_value.title: New Value
new_value.description: Value after the change, in the same form as `old_value`.

change_date.title: Change Date
change_date.description: Date the registry published the update.

detected_at.title: Detected At
detected_at.description: When Pav recorded the change (UTC); the feed is ordered by it. History loaded when the feed started carries its `change_date` at midnight UTC.

data.title: Data
data.description: Page of trial change events, newest first.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page; pass it back as `?cursor=`. Null when this page exhausts the feed. Stable under concurrent inserts (unlike `offset`).

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: Durable Pav program identifier linked to this trial.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Slug of the company that owns the linked program.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier that owns the linked program.

drug.title: Drug
drug.description: Drug/asset name of the linked program.

error.description: Error detail. Present only on 4xx/5xx responses.

request_id.description: Correlation id echoed in the `X-Request-ID` response header. Quote it when contacting Pav support about a failed request.
request_id.title: Request Id

EnterpriseApiKey.description: Use a personal or organization Pav API key from Pav developer settings. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

tags.name: companies

tags.name: trials

tags.name: deals

tags.name: patents
tags.description: US patent families from USPTO with owners linked to Pav companies, member applications, ownership history, and statutory term.

tags.name: fda
tags.description: FDA records with applicants linked to Pav companies: Orange Book products, patents and exclusivities, Purple Book biologics, orphan designations, warning letters, and recalls.

tags.name: changes
tags.description: Detected pipeline movement events per company — added and removed assets and phase changes — with before/after phase and detection time.

tags.name: stats
tags.description: High-level dataset counts and facet coverage.
